study type: economic evaluation based on a randomised controlled trial
exposure: MiniMedTM 780G advanced hybrid closed loop (AHCL) therapy
standard insulin therapy (SoC, mainly open-loop insulin pump therapy)
outcome: hospitalisations (due to severe hypoglycaemia and dysregulated diabetes)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with type 1 diabetes (T1D).
finding: Advanced hybrid closed loop (AHCL) therapy during pregnancy was estimated to be cost-saving by 232.57 per individual compared to standard insulin therapy (SoC), primarily due to savings from shorter and less frequent hospital admissions.
